system.effect: Run a Silk Line between two points up to 5 squares apart — as your Action, or for 1 Silk Point to skip the roll. It's safe footing the crew can climb or cross with no Acrobatics roll: up a wall, across a gap, along a ceiling. It holds up to two spiders at once and stays until it's broken or the scene ends.
system.description: Silk is always available. It also does the small stuff without ceremony — anchoring a drop, tying off a light object, lowering a crewmate.

system.effect: For 2 Silk Points, build a small web structure with no roll — a net, a tripwire, a platform, or a hammock.
system.description: The hammock has no tactical use. The Tinkerer built it anyway.

system.effect:
A one-use gadget cobbled from materials at hand. Pick one effect when you build it:

  • Bypass: defeat one small mechanical obstacle within reach — no roll.
  • Boost: hand it to a crewmate for +2 dice on their next roll.
  • Distraction: set it off in a target square within 6, pulling every nearby NPC's attention there for one round.
system.description: The Tinkerer's specialty. The ST can veto materials that clearly aren't available.

system.effect: A found object. Turning a bottle cap into a shield is an Easy (WIT + Engineering) repurpose.
system.description: The location is full of things a spider can use. This is one of the good ones.

system.effect: A found object. A lever, a lockpick blank, a structural spar — repurpose with WIT + Engineering, Difficulty scaling with ambition.
system.description: The Tinkerer has plans for this. The Tinkerer has plans for everything.

system.effect: A found object. Tension, a launcher, a latch-release component. Three rubber bands and a thumbtack into a working latch-release is not Easy.
system.description: Stores energy. Occasionally releases it at the intended moment.
